2609.21221.title: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Framework for Perceptual Task Planning
2609.21221.paper_summary: Perceptual planning tasks require two key capabilities: accurately perceiving uncertain scenes and planning valid action sequences following logical rules. Conventional methods convert perception into discrete symbolic facts and then plan, discarding perceptual uncertainty and severing task-level feedback to perception. We introduce a generic, fully differentiable neuro-soft-symbolic framework that connects visual perception and task planning within a single computational graph. The framework maintains a continuous soft symbolic state, lifts domain rules into a differentiable soft-$T_P$ transition operator, and optimizes action logits over a short planning horizon. Gradients from the planning objective can also update the perception parameters, allowing task-relevant perceptual representations to be refined during planning. On Blocksworld, our method solves 40/40 LatPlan-40 tasks and 596/600 PlanBench-600 tasks, compared with 33/40 for LatPlan and 587/600 for the reasoning-model baseline, while requiring substantially less computation and time. In the perceptual-uncertainty ablation, our method improves the success rate from 59\% with frozen perception to 83\%. We further conduct task-and-motion simulations on Blocksworld scenes, providing an execution-level validation of the compatibility between decoded task plans and downstream robotic motion execution.
2609.21221.paper_summary_zh: 感知規劃任務需要兩個關鍵能力：準確感知不確定場景和根據邏輯規則規劃有效的行動序列。傳統方法將感知轉換為離散的符號事實，然後進行規劃，捨棄感知的不確定性並切斷任務層級對感知的反饋。我們介紹了一個通用的、完全可微的神經-軟符號框架，將視覺感知和任務規劃連接在一個計算圖中。該框架維持一個連續的軟符號狀態，將領域規則提升為可微的軟-$T_P$ 轉換運算子，並在短期規劃範圍內優化行動邏輯。來自規劃目標的梯度也可以更新感知參數，允許在規劃過程中精煉與任務相關的感知表示。在 Blocksworld 中，我們的方法解決了 40/40 LatPlan-40 任務和 596/600 PlanBench-600 任務，而 LatPlan 的結果為 33/40，推理模型基準的結果為 587/600，同時所需的計算和時間大幅減少。在感知不確定性消融實驗中，我們的方法將成功率從 59\%（固定感知）提高到 83\%。我們還在 Blocksworld 場景上進行了任務和運動模擬，提供了解碼任務計劃與下游機器人運動執行之間兼容性的執行級驗證。
